# Taehyeon Kim (김태현)

> Taehyeon Kim (김태현) is a KAIST AI Ph.D. and Senior Member of Technical Staff at
> Holiday Robotics. His research focuses on efficient LLM inference and adaptive reasoning,
> which he is extending to embodied agents.

- Official website: https://kthyeon.com/
- Also known as: Kim Taehyeon, 김태현, Kthyeon
- Current role: Senior Member of Technical Staff, Holiday Robotics (https://holiday-robotics.com/)
- Previously: LG AI Research (Tech Lead and Research Scientist, Superintelligence Lab), Google Research, Qualcomm AI, Dynamo AI (YC W22)
- Education: Ph.D. in AI, KAIST, advised by Prof. Se-Young Yun in the OSI Lab. B.S. in Mathematical Sciences, KAIST
- Contact: kimtaehyeon610 [at] gmail [dot] com

## Research focus

- Efficient LLM inference and adaptive reasoning: learning when to reason and accelerating answer generation through adaptive thinking, parallel decoding, and speculative decoding.
- Learning from feedback: using reinforcement learning, evaluation, and adaptive training data to improve reasoning quality and computational efficiency.
- Current direction at Holiday Robotics: embodied agents that select and compose robot skills, supported by evaluation, synthetic trajectories, and automatic labeling of real-world robot data.

## Selected work experience

- Holiday Robotics: Senior Member of Technical Staff, June 2026–present. Founding member, Embodied AI Team.
- LG AI Research, April 2025–June 2026: Research Scientist (April–August 2025), Squad Lead, Superintelligence Lab (September–December 2025), and Tech Lead, Superintelligence Lab (January–June 2026). RL, efficient and effective LLM inference, search agents, and adaptive reasoning. Worked with Moontae Lee.
- Google Research: Ph.D. Research Intern, October–December 2023. Efficient LLM inference. Worked with Adrian Benton and Ananda Theertha Suresh.
- Dynamo AI: Ph.D. Research Intern, January–May 2023. Worked with Eric Lin.
- Qualcomm AI: Ph.D. Research Intern, June–December 2021. Worked with Heesoo Myeong.

Roles and dates follow the owner's LinkedIn experience supplied in September 2026.
The October 2026 CV uses the same current role and research focus.

## Research background

Efficient inference, adaptive reasoning, and LLM alignment, with earlier work on knowledge
distillation, noisy-label learning, and federated learning. Published at ACL, ICLR, NeurIPS, and IJCAI.

## Representative research

- Contrastive Thinking Decoding: NeurIPS 2026; first author. Steering answer generation in reasoning models.
- RPO: ACL 2026, Oral; first author. Adaptive thinking through root-token policy optimization. https://aclanthology.org/2026.acl-long.816/
- Multi-Drafter Speculative Decoding with Alignment Feedback: ACL 2026, Findings; co-first author. Speculative decoding with multiple drafters and alignment feedback.
- Instructive Decoding: ICLR 2024, Spotlight; co-first author. Instruction-guided decoding for noisy instructions.
- Accelerating Blockwise Parallel Language Models with Draft Refinement: NeurIPS 2024; first author, Google Research collaboration. https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2024/hash/3c9629e718d931e8d4d240378aa1d3bf-Abstract-Conference.html
- Comparing Kullback-Leibler Divergence and Mean Squared Error Loss in Knowledge Distillation: IJCAI 2021; co-first author. Comparing KL and MSE objectives for knowledge distillation.

## Additional publication details

- Contrastive Thinking Decoding: Steering Answer Generation in Reasoning Models. Taehyeon Kim, Youngsoo Jang, Hyunsoo Lee, Yu Jin Kim, Moontae Lee. NeurIPS 2026.
- Efficiently Learning To Reason or Not to Reason: Root-token Policy Optimization for Adaptive Thinking. Taehyeon Kim, Hyunsoo Lee, Youngsoo Jang, Moontae Lee. ACL 2026, Oral.
- Multi-Drafter Speculative Decoding with Alignment Feedback. Taehyeon Kim*, Hojung Jung*, Se-Young Yun. ACL 2026, Findings.
- Accelerating Blockwise Parallel Language Models with Draft Refinement. Taehyeon Kim, Ananda Theertha Suresh, Kishore Papineni, Michael Riley, Sanjiv Kumar, Adrian Benton. NeurIPS 2024.
- Instructive Decoding: Instruction-Tuned Large Language Models are Self-Refiner from Noisy Instructions. Taehyeon Kim*, Joonkee Kim*, Gihun Lee*, Se-Young Yun. ICLR 2024, Spotlight.
- Navigating Data Heterogeneity in Federated Learning: A Semi-Supervised Federated Object Detection. Taehyeon Kim, Eric Lin, Junu Lee, Christian Lau, Vaikkunth Mugunthan. NeurIPS 2023.
- FINE Samples for Learning with Noisy Labels. Taehyeon Kim*, Jongwoo Ko*, Sangwook Cho, Jinhwan Choi, Se-Young Yun. NeurIPS 2021.
- Comparing Kullback-Leibler Divergence and Mean Squared Error Loss in Knowledge Distillation. Taehyeon Kim*, Jaehoon Oh*, Nak Yil Kim, Sangwook Cho, Se-Young Yun. IJCAI 2021.
